siteSettings.shortAbout: Shirvaiker Strategic Consulting is a mentoring and advisory practice founded by Prof. Sunil S. Shirvaiker, blending nearly four decades of corporate leadership and higher-education experience. We help individuals and organisations move from "Clutter to Clarity" through evidence-based, precision-led guidance. Our work spans career counselling, statistics and quality (Six Sigma / SPC) consulting, combining scientific psychometric tools with real-world industry insight. Whether guiding a student’s stream choice or sharpening an organisation’s analytical rigour, our approach is calculated, personalised and outcome-focused. Strategy-led growth is at the heart of everything we do.
siteSettings.strapline: Precision in Guidance, Excellence in Performance

about.bio: I am Prof. Sunil S. Shirvaiker, Founder & Chief Mentor of Shirvaiker Strategic Consulting. My career spans nearly four decades across two interconnected worlds — high-stakes corporate leadership and elite higher education. For 24+ years I held senior roles across the pharmaceutical, research and analytics sectors, including Director of Operations and Director of Quality & Business Research at IQVIA (IMS Health India), and DGM – Strategic Business Research at Sun Pharma, with earlier roles at Novartis, Sandoz and Siemens. I then spent over 13 years as Program Director, HOD and Area Chairperson (Placements) at SVKM’s NMIMS – Nilkamal School of Mathematics, Applied Statistics & Analytics, where I continue as Visiting Faculty. I hold a B.Sc. and M.Sc. in Statistics from the University of Mumbai, a Diploma in Marketing Management from NMIMS, and a Six Sigma (IT) Green Belt. As a Mentoria-Certified Career Counsellor (Advance and Ascend levels), I blend scientific psychometric testing with real industry experience to help people move from “Clutter to Clarity.” Precision in Guidance. Excellence in Performance.

services.description: Evidence-based career counselling that blends scientific psychometric assessment with decades of cross-industry insight. We build personalised, multi-year roadmaps that align an individual’s interests, personality and abilities with real market demand — from stream selection to executive career pivots.
services.title: Career Counselling & Guidance
services.whoItsFor: School students (Grades 8–12), college graduates & postgraduates, and working professionals.

services.description: Focused guidance at every academic crossroad — from school stream selection through to undergraduate course choices and postgraduate decisions. We help students and parents decode the options, weigh specialisations and institutions, and match them to aptitude and long-term goals, reducing guesswork at critical decision points.
services.title: Admission & Stream Guidance
services.whoItsFor: School students and their parents; college aspirants; and college undergraduates deciding on postgraduate studies and specialisations.

services.description: Applied statistical consulting for industry — using rigorous data analysis, statistical and predictive modelling, forecasting and research methods to solve a wide range of business problems. Backed by decades of corporate research and analytics experience across the pharmaceutical, financial-services, market-research and manufacturing sectors, we help organisations turn data into confident decisions.
services.title: Statistical Consulting
services.whoItsFor: Companies and organisations across sectors seeking to solve data, analytics and business problems.

services.description: Practical quality-management consulting in Six Sigma and Statistical Process Control, translating rigorous methodology into measurable process improvement.
services.title: Quality Consulting — Six Sigma / SPC
services.whoItsFor: Organisations, teams and professionals seeking process excellence.
